message: Android 0.1.67 (68) adds user-confirmed public article collection, standard LIVE and authorized JPEG Motion Photo intake, local playback/editing, and stability improvements for image display, backups and external imports. It does not claim every proprietary OEM motion format. The existing signature and package identity are preserved: overwrite-install without uninstalling or clearing app data, and back up important materials first. The frozen signed R8 APK passed 907 automated tests with zero failures, errors or skips, lint, APK v2 signing, 16 KiB alignment and exact OPPO installed-APK readback. OPPO native regression and production UI covered media/document grouping, content duplicates, package/backup/recycle and real file-manager/browser import; original user rows and 153 original file-path states remained unchanged. Latest-candidate Redmi, WeChat/QQ/email/cloud-drive source coverage and successful human-authenticated locked-target import remain unverified, not claimed passed. This is an official direct-download update; AppBao requires a separate store submission and review.
